messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Oversight  

Hi Alex,  

I’m sorry for missing the deadline on the report yesterday. It was inconsiderate and I know it put extra pressure on you. I value our teamwork and will make sure it doesn’t happen again. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to help catch up.  

Thank you,  
Jordan  

PLAN: Draft apology email with clear subject and sincere tone  
PLAN: Review email for brevity and appropriateness  
PLAN: Send the email to the colleague after final check
